failures.question: 商品动销率是多少？（有销量的商品数 / 全部商品数）
failures.generatedSql:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS n
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
),
allp AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM products)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * s.n / a.n, 2) AS sell_through_pct
FROM sold s CROSS JOIN allp a;

failures.question: 会员与非会员的复购率分别是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH user_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         BOOL_OR(m.member_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_member,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN is_member THEN 'member' ELSE 'non_member' END AS user_type,
       SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_rate_pct
FROM user_orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
